dialogues.speaker: Honorine
dialogues.text: Of course! This is the Eremites we speak of, you know! You're an adventurer. I'm sure you've met many a fool nabbed by Eremite bands!

dialogues.speaker: Honorine
dialogues.text: I do so dearly wish to visit the desert and witness Khaenri'ahn machines for myself, but I have no desire to become such a laughingstock!

dialogues.speaker: Honorine
dialogues.text: In fact, I would land myself in even hotter waters were I to accidentally hire an outlaw.

dialogues.speaker: Honorine
dialogues.text: Ugh, how shall I get to the desert...
